title: Rust: key store client
description: Acceptance: Rust client for key operations
close_reason: Implemented KeyStoreClient in rust/lichen-client/src/keystore.rs with: list(), get(), pin(), delete() methods; IID validation with validate_iid(); IidError and KeyStoreError types; 19 tests covering IID format validation from keystore_iid.json vectors. Client uses lichen-coap transport with 5.03 backoff tracking. Available via 'tokio' feature flag.
